title: Australia Plans E-Bike Safety Rules as Use And Injuries Soar
title_cn: 随着使用和伤害激增，澳大利亚计划制定电动自行车安全规则
summary: Australia is planning national safety standards to govern e-bikes, whose popularity has soared in recent years, along with serious injuries and deaths linked to their use.
